title: Safety in the Techno-mediated City: Lessons from Bengaluru's AI-powered CCTV Network
descriptions: This dataset is used to explore how the notion of safety as a value is understood in different phases of the development of technology systems for women's safety, especially AI-powered CCTV systems. The dataset consists of textual, image, and video data collected online, as shown in the metadata document.
